job.name: ig17_host_5
job.meaning: Мужчина ~45, ухоженная борода, тёмно-синий джемпер, кабинет с книгами и тёплой лампой — «уверенный наставник, финансовый советник»
job.prompt: Photorealistic photo of a calm confident Russian man about 45 with short dark hair greying at the temples and a neat beard, a dark navy merino jumper over a white collar. FRAMING: vertical 9:16, medium close shot from the chest up, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm, warm, knowing expression, NO broad smile. Look: a real frame from a phone camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark. Background: a quiet home study with bookshelves and a warm desk lamp, softly blurred, evening light.
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary person (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
